SIDEOUT MMRDOUBLES
—
Finding your level

Your rating starts at 1200. Every recorded win earns 20–40 points, based on the average rating of each duo.

0 games0 wins

Sideout is its own rating system. Both teammates earn the same win points. The losing duo loses the corresponding amount, with a minimum player rating of 100.

HOW YOUR RATING MOVES

Good games count.

Beat a duo 100+ MMR lower+20
Beat an evenly matched duo+30
Beat a duo 50 MMR higher+35
Beat a duo 100+ MMR higher+40

Smaller MMR gaps scale the award between 20 and 40. Team averages set your points. One player records the result, and all four ratings update together.

EVERY GAME HAS ITS WEIGHT

A fair match.
A fair rating.

The two player ratings form your team average. Equal duos earn +30 for a win. Beat a duo 100 MMR higher for +40, or 100 MMR lower for +20. Smaller gaps scale between 20 and 40. The losing duo loses the winner’s gain.

Beat a duo 100 MMR lower+20 each ↗Beat a duo 100 MMR higher+40 each ↗

Add your card to Instagram
  1. Tap Save PNG to save your card.

YOUR MATCH. YOUR FORMAT.

Set up your match.

Choose the rules before sending your challenge. The other duo will see these settings before accepting.

Best of 3 ends when a duo wins 2 sets; best of 5 ends at 3. Win by 2 allows extra points until a duo leads by two.
